name: Hangman Tree

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

description: Creatures larger than Medium take up more than 1 square. For instance, an ogre takes up a space that is 2 squares by 2 squares. Most Large and larger creatures also have a reach greater than 1, which means they can make melee attacks against creatures that aren’t adjacent to them. A creature’s basic body shape usually determines its reach; a Large ogre has a reach of 2, but a Large horse has a reach of 1.

traits.name: Pulling Grab
traits.details: The tree can attempt to move a grabbed target as part of any action during which the tree also moves. It gains a +4 bonus to the Strength check to do so, and on a success, the tree can move up to its full speed.

hit.description: damage, and the tree grabs the target (escape DC 17). Until the grab ends, the target takes ongoing 5 damage. The grab persists even if the tree is unable to take actions.

effect.description: The tree uses noose vine twice.

powers.name: Swallow
powers.usageDetails: when the tree has no creature swallowed

attacks.name: Attack
attacks.targets: one creature the tree is grabbing

hit.description: damage, the grab ends, and the target is swallowed (escape DC 17). While swallowed, the target is removed from play, and it takes ongoing 10 acid damage. When the effect ends or the tree drops to 0 hit points, the target appears in an unoccupied square of its choice adjacent to the tree.
The tree pulls the target up to 4 squares.

effect.description: The tree disguises itself to appear as a Huge tree or treant until it uses deceptive veil again or drops to 0 hit points. Other creatures can make a DC 30 Insight check to discern the form is an illusion.
